# ChunkMeshPending

> **Kind:** tag · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/terrain/`](../folders/src-logic-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h)

## Summary

Chunk waits for a marching cubes dispatch.

## Description

Emplaced by ChunkGeneratorSys::collect next to ChunkVolume; removed by TerrainSys once it has recorded the chunk's compute dispatch.

None (tag, opaque type or no data members).
